lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਬੰਦੀਖਾਨਾ ਅਉਗਣ ਪੈਰਿ ਲੁਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: lab adheraa ba(n)deekhaanaa augan pair luhaaree ||3||
lines.translation: Greed is the dark dungeon, and demerits are the shackles on his feet. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਮੁਦਗਰ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਕੋੁਟਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: poo(n)jee maar pavai nit mudagar paap kare koutavaaree ||
lines.translation: His wealth constantly batters him, and sin acts as the police officer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: bhaavai cha(n)gaa bhaavai ma(n)daa jaisee nadar tumhaaree ||4||
lines.translation: Whether the mortal is good or bad, he is as You look upon him, O Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ ਅਲਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੇਖਾਂ ਆਈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad purakh kau alahu kaheeai sekhaa(n) aaee vaaree ||
lines.translation: The Primal Lord God is called Allah. The Shaykh's turn has now come.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਲ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਐਸੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਚਾਲੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: deval devatiaa kar laagaa aisee keerat chaalee ||5||
lines.translation: The temples of the gods are subject to taxes; this is what it has come to. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂਜਾ ਬਾਂਗ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਨੀਲ ਰੂਪ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: koojaa baa(n)g nivaaj musalaa neel roop banavaaree ||
lines.translation: The Muslim devotional pots, calls to prayer, prayers and prayer mats are everywhere; the Lord appears in blue robes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੀਆ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਜੀਆਂ ਬੋਲੀ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ghar meeaa sabhanaa(n) jeeaa(n) bolee avar tumaaree ||6||
lines.translation: In each and every home, everyone uses Muslim greetings; your speech has changed, O people. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮੀਰ ਮਹੀਪਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: je too meer maheepat saahib kudarat kaun hamaaree ||
lines.translation: You, O my Lord and Master, are the King of the earth; what power do I have to challenge You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਕਰਹਿਗੇ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: chaare ku(n)t salaam karahige ghar ghar siphat tumhaaree ||7||
lines.translation: In the four directions, people bow in humble adoration to You; Your Praises are sung in each and every heart. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath si(n)mrit pu(n)n daan kichh laahaa milai dihaaRee ||
lines.translation: Making pilgrimages to sacred shrines, reading the Simritees and giving donations in charity - these do bring any profit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਕਾ ਘੜੀ ਸਮੑਾਲੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee mekaa ghaRee samhaalee ||8||1||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, glorious greatness is obtained in an instant, remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲੁ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol ghar 2 mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Basant Hindol, Second House, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaa(n)iaa nagar ik baalak vasiaa khin pal thir na rahaaee ||
lines.translation: Within the body-village there lives a child who cannot hold still, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anik upaav jatan kar thaake baara(n) baar bharamaaee ||1||
lines.translation: It makes so many efforts, and grows weary, but still, it wanders restlessly again and again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere thaakur baalak ikat ghar aan ||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, Your child has come home, to be one with You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai ta pooraa paaeeai bhaj raam naam neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, he finds the Perfect Lord. Meditating and vibrating on the Name of the Lord, he receives the Insignia of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਮੜਾ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu miratak maRaa sareer hai sabh jag jit raam naam nahee vasiaa ||
lines.translation: These are dead corpses, these bodies of all the people of the world; the Name of the Lord does not dwell in them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਦਕੁ ਚੁਆਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam gur udak chuaaiaa phir hariaa hoaa rasiaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Guru leads us to taste the water of the Lord's Name, and then we savor and enjoy it, and our bodies are rejuvenated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai nirakhat nirakhat sareer sabh khojiaa ik guramukh chalat dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have examined and studied and searched my entire body, and as Gurmukh, I behold a miraculous wonder.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਮੁਏ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: baahar khoj mue sabh saakat har guramatee ghar paaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: All the faithless cynics searched outside and died, but following the Guru's Teachings, I have found the Lord within the home of my own heart. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: deenaa deen daiaal bhae hai jiu krisan bidar ghar aaiaa ||
lines.translation: God is Merciful to the meekest of the meek; Krishna came to the house of Bidar, a devotee of low social status.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਧਾਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਗੈ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: milio sudaamaa bhaavanee dhaar sabh kichh aagai daalad bha(n)j samaaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: Sudama loved God, who came to meet him; God sent everything to his home, and ended his poverty. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਵਡੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam kee paij vaderee mere thaakur aap rakhaaee ||
lines.translation: Great is the glory of the Name of the Lord. My Lord and Master Himself has enshrined it within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਘਟਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: je sabh saakat karahi bakheelee ik ratee til na ghataaee ||5||
lines.translation: Even if all the faithless cynics continue slandering me, it is not diminished by even one iota. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan kee usatat hai raam naamaa dah dis sobhaa paaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is the praise of His humble servant. It brings him honor in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਖਵਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੂਕੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak saakat khav na sakai til apanai ghar lookee laaee ||6||
lines.translation: The slanderers and the faithless cynics cannot endure it at all; they have set fire to their own houses. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan kau jan mil sobhaa paavai gun mahi gun paragaasaa ||
lines.translation: The humble person meeting with another humble person obtains honor. In the glory of the Lord, their glory shines forth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: mere thaakur ke jan preetam piaare jo hovahi daasan daasaa ||7||
lines.translation: The servants of my Lord and Master are loved by the Beloved. They are the slaves of His slaves. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape jal apara(n)par karataa aape mel milaavai ||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself is the Water; He Himself unites us in His Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh sahaj milaae jiu jal jalahi samaavai ||8||1||9||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in celestial peace and poise, like water blending with water. ||8||1||9||
